messages.text:
One important platform-specific invariant emerged: on Windows, default hidden filtering is based on file attributes, and files created under the hidden `.tura` directory inherited hidden status in the probe.

I’ll avoid baking that artifact into the port by generating verifier fixtures outside hidden parents and by honoring Windows hidden attributes where available.

commands.commandLine: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force probe-eza | Out-Null; Set-Content -NoNewline probe-eza/a.txt "hello"; Set-Content -NoNewline probe-eza/B2 "12"; Set-Content -NoNewline probe-eza/b10 "123"; Set-Content -NoNewline probe-eza/.hidden "x"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force probe-eza/dir | Out-Null; Set-Content -NoNewline probe-eza/dir/z "z"; $ref = (Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt).Trim(); & $ref --color=never --icons=never probe-eza; Write-Output "<EXIT:$LASTEXITCODE>"
